Author: topstockalerts
Text: Coca-Cola Hires Monster Energy Executive to Lead North American Operations Coca-Cola will appoint Rob Gehring, head of Monster Beverage’s Americas business, to lead its North American operations starting Dec. 1. Gehring, 59, joined Monster in 2024 as chief growth officer and assumed his current role in February. The appointment comes as Coca-Cola seeks to sustain growth amid weaker U.S. consumer spending caused by higher food and gasoline costs. Coke reported 7% net sales growth in Q2, while North American volume increased 3%. Monster, meanwhile, posted 20% net sales growth in Q2, benefiting from continued innovation in the energy-drink category. Coca-Cola has also been expanding beyond traditional soda with products such as refreshers and dirty sodas. Before joining Monster, Gehring was CEO of Swire Coca-Cola USA, giving him previous experience within Coke’s bottling network. Coca-Cola shares are up more than 25% this year, while Monster has gained more than 12%. $KO
